longDescription:
Gentle-Emotex turns a Ulanzi D200 key into a small screen for the Gentle-Emotex emitter: the pixel-art Gentleman that acts out what a coding agent is doing. Gentle-Emotex is a fork of Gentle-Emote, and this plugin is that fork's D200 receiver — the emitter runs in your terminal (Pi or Gentle Shell), while this key mirrors the frames it sends. This plugin draws only what it receives; it never redraws the sender's output or speaks for either project.

How the D200 receiver works:
1. Receives the Gentle-Emotex external-display protocol v1 (HTTP POST with an image/png body and X-Emote-* metadata headers) on 127.0.0.1, port 8003 by default. The receiver needs an emitter extended for the D200: point the compatible emitter's externalDisplay.url at the address shown on the key.
2. Scales each 64x64 frame with an exact 3x nearest-neighbour factor onto the 196x196 key grid, centred on a black canvas, so pixel-art edges stay crisp instead of blurring.
3. Offers an optional Fill scaling mode that stretches the frame across the whole key.
4. Binds strict fixed ports: the receiver uses exactly the port you configure and never switches on its own. If a fixed port is already taken (a second instance or another tool), the keys on that port show a clear PORT IN USE error instead of a frame — no stale image, no fallback. Pressing the key with legacy senders only redraws the current frame.
5. Mirrors by port group: several keys sharing a configured port mirror one receiver's newest frame, while keys on different ports are fully independent — their own receiver, frame, focus queue and render cache.
6. Keeps the newest frame only: the animation never lags behind the sender, because intermediate frames are dropped by design.
7. Needs no account, no cloud service, and no network beyond the local loopback interface.

Press-to-focus: pressing a key asks the emitter to focus the session shown on that key, when the session metadata allows it. Focus delivery requires a compatible emitter that supports the D200 focus protocol (DEDICATED-SUCCESS-v1); the emitter confirms only confirmed focus success, and legacy frames stay display-only.

Compatibility: Ulanzi D200 with Ulanzi Studio 2.1.4 or later on Windows 10+ and macOS 12+, with a compatible external emitter (Node 20.12.2 or later) configured as the frame source.
